# How to refund an order

:::steps
Open the order in the admin panel.

Confirm the refund window has not passed.

Issue the refund through the orders service.
:::

:::tabs
## Storefront

Customers request a refund from their order history page.

## Orders service

Support agents issue the refund directly against the order record.
:::

:::flow
customer -> support: request refund
support -> orders: issue refund
orders -> customer: refund confirmation
:::
